verdict.rationale: Check publishes a first-party Postman collection that walks through creating companies, workplaces, employees and payrolls, which gives users runnable examples. Its sandbox environment lets users experiment with API calls safely. However, nothing in the evidence shows the docs' API reference itself is interactive, with in-page try-it consoles or runnable snippets. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs API reference with try-it/runnable request execution, detail on per-endpoint example coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: This guide will run you through our Postman collection that demonstrates how to create companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls
Experiment with API calls without affecting real companies or employees
